title: Austin Municipal Judge Appointed
summary:
*   The Austin City Council convened a special meeting dedicated to a single, critical personnel matter.
*   A closed-door executive session was held to discuss the appointment of an Associate Judge for the Municipal Court.
*   Following the executive session, the Council publicly and unanimously approved Pam Landcaster as the new Associate Judge for the Municipal Court.

Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Mayor McClellan
called to order the Special Called Meeting of the Council, noting the presence of all
Councilmembers. The Mayor announced the purpose of the meeting is to publicly announce
that during the meeting the Council will convene in a closed or executive session
authorized by Article 6252-17, Section 2, Paragraph G, Texas Revised Civil Statutes
Annotated, to discuss the appointment of the Associate Judge of the Municipal Court.
EXECUTIVE SESSION Mayor McClellan announced that Council will convene in a closed or
executive session authorized by Section 2, Paragraph (g) of Article 6252-17, Texas Revised
Civil Statutes, concerning the discussion of the appointment of the Associate Judge of the
Municipal Court; and after such closed or executive session, any final action, decision or
vote with regard to any matter considered in the closed or executive session will be made
in open session, should such action, decision or vote be necessary.
Motion
On Councilmember Goodman's motion and Mayor Pro Tem Trevino's second, the Council approved
the appointment of Pam Landcaster to be the Associate Judge of the Municipal Court. (7-0
vote)| ADJOURNMENT The Council adjourned its meeting at 5:35 Ρ.Μ.
